name: Helping Each Other
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of mutual support and love among believers as a reflection of Christ's law and discipleship. Ecclesiastes highlights the practical benefits of partnership in labor, while Galatians calls Christians to bear one another's burdens, fulfilling Christ's command. John teaches that love for one another is the identifying mark of Jesus' followers, and Proverbs contrasts this with the harm caused by those who betray trust, underscoring the value of faithfulness in relationships.
